_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series D3CBA/1 Set-3. 24 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22 (each odd index 3-21 is the Hindi of the page after it); idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, confirmed at full size; the cover announces 23 printed pages. Odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet: all open with Hindi. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 x1, B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4 (case-based); instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme for a bare OR: Q21, 27, 34, 35, 36, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 8 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Marking scheme is per-set: every page footer reads 'X SCIENCE 31/1/3 PAGE N' (13 pages). All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived: Q10 (= 31/1/1 Q9) disagrees and Q5 (= 31/1/1 Q10) is arguable, both flagged as on the opener. No void or award-regardless note anywhere in the scheme. No decimal numbers on this paper. Sibling of 31/1/1 (plan.txt gave no skip list): 41 rows are the opener's questions, reshuffled and renumbered, each confirmed on this paper's page and copied byte for byte from 2024-31-1-1; 12 rows are new to this set and transcribed fresh (Q12, Q14, Q21A/B, Q22, Q23, Q25, Q31, Q32, Q33, Q34A/B). The shared rows print a space before '?' in a few places where the opener's transcription has none (Q27, Q35(B), Q37(i), Q39(iii)(B)); treated as typesetting and copied from the reference.
